'''Quests''' is an openable Interface that can be used to review the Player's unfinished Quests.

Every day, you can earn 300 gems from daily quests! This is the easiest way to get gems so far.

== Information ==
Quests are separated into 3 different Categories. '''Event''', '''Daily''' and '''Main''' quests.

* '''Daily''' quests are quests that are granted every 24 hours. These quests are randomized for everyone and give '''Gems''' as a reward for completing them.
* '''Event''' quests are quests that are granted during an Event.
* '''Main''' quests are the Player's '''World''' quests. These can be completed from time to time as you progress further through the Story.
